title: Correlated Subqueries
description: Use correlated subqueries to compute values per row.

data.text: Correlated subqueries reference the outer query. Use EXISTS, IN, or scalar subqueries.

data.title: EXISTS
data.code:
SELECT id, email
FROM users u
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM orders o
  WHERE o.user_id = u.id
    AND o.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
);

data.title: EXISTS vs IN
data.text: Use EXISTS when the subquery is large or uses indexes efficiently.

data.title: Exercise: Find VIP Users
data.description: Find users with at least one order over 500.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Correlated subqueries reference the outer query.
